hero.lead: Post your stories, poems and essays, one chapter at a time, and find the people who want to read them.

free.title: Free to read and write
free.body: No paywall for readers or for writers.

yours.title: Your work stays yours
yours.body: You keep the rights. Publish it anywhere else, any time.

noTracking.title: No tracking ads
noTracking.body: Ads match the page you’re on and are the same for everyone. Never inside a story, never full screen.

person.title: A person reads every report
person.body: If something feels wrong, report it. Our moderators look at each one.

signUp.heading: Create your account
signUp.subheading: It takes a minute. One account for reading and writing.

email.label: Email
email.hint: We’ll send you a link to confirm it.

password.label: Password
password.hint: At least 10 characters. You can paste it from a password manager. We check it isn’t on a list of leaked passwords.

signUp.useLink: Email me a log-in link instead
signUp.linkNote: We’ll email you a link to log in, each time. No password to remember.

birthYear.label: Year of birth
birthYear.why: Why we ask for your year of birth
birthYear.tooltip: We ask for the year, and sometimes the month, to pick the right safety settings.
birthYear.tooltipWithAgeCheck: We ask for the year, and sometimes the month, to pick the right safety settings. A quick age check comes next.
birthYear.ageCheckLine: A quick age check comes next.

errors.emailInvalid: Enter an email address, for example name@example.com.
errors.passwordsDiffer: The two passwords are different. Type the same password twice.
errors.passwordLeaked: This password is on a list of leaked passwords, so someone could guess it. Choose another one.
errors.termsNotAccepted: Tick the box to agree to the Terms and confirm you’ve read the Privacy notice.
errors.refused: We couldn’t create the account. Check your invitation and your answers, then try again.
errors.weakPassword: Choose a longer password, at least 10 characters.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many tries in a short time. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.unreachable: We couldn’t reach our server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.legalNotLoaded: We couldn’t load the Terms and the Privacy notice, so you can’t sign up yet. Check your connection and reload the page.
errors.disposableEmail: This email address comes from a service that hands out throwaway addresses, so it can’t be used for an account. Please use an address you keep.

sent.heading: Confirm your email
sent.body: We sent a link to {{email}}. Until you open it, you can read stories but you can’t publish, comment, post or send messages.
sent.bodyLink: We sent a log-in link to {{email}}. Open it on this device to finish joining.
sent.spam: Nothing after a few minutes? Check your spam folder.

birthMonth.label: Month of birth
birthMonth.why: Why we ask for the month
birthMonth.tooltip: You turn {{older}} this year. The month tells us if you’re {{younger}} or {{older}} now, so you get the right settings.

refusal.heading: Sorry, you can’t create an account right now.
refusal.under13: We don’t keep anything you typed. You can try again once you turn 13.
refusal.adultsOnly: Thanks for wanting to join. This early test is for invited adults only. {{productName}} opens to everyone aged 13 and over later. We haven’t kept anything you typed.
refusal.underMarketAge: {{productName}} isn’t open to under-{{age}}s in {{country}} yet. We haven’t kept anything you typed.

signUp.handleHint: 3 to 30 characters. People use it to find and mention you. You can add a pen name later.

invite.heading: The test is by invitation
invite.body: {{productName}} is in an early test with invited writers. If someone gave you an invitation, enter its code to join. We don’t keep anything you type here.
invite.codeHint: It’s in the link you were sent, after /join/.
invite.codeRequired: Enter the code from your invitation.
invite.accepted: Invitation accepted. Create your account below.
invite.ended: This invitation has ended, ask the person who invited you for a new one.
invite.unknown: We don’t recognise this invitation code. Check it and try again.
invite.unreachable: We couldn’t check the invitation. Check your connection and try again.

confirm.doneBody: Welcome to {{productName}}. You’re logged in on this device.
confirm.failedHeading: This link doesn’t work any more
confirm.failedBody: Links work once and expire after an hour. Sign up again with the same email to get a new one.

signIn.heading: Log in
signIn.subheading: Pick up where you left off. Forgot your password? You can reset it here.
signIn.linkSent: If there’s an account for {{email}}, we’ve sent it a log-in link. Open it on this device.
signIn.emailMissing: Type the email you joined with.
signIn.wrongDetailsTitle: That email and password don’t match.
signIn.wrongDetailsBody: Check both and try again, or reset your password.
signIn.pausedTitle: Logging in is paused for {{minutes}} minutes.
signIn.pausedBody: There were {{tries}} wrong tries in a row. Wait until {{time}} and try again, or reset your password now.
signIn.notConfirmed: Confirm your email first: open the link we sent when you joined. Can’t find it? Join again with the same email to get a new one.
signIn.tooManyAttempts: Too many tries in a short time. Wait a few minutes and try again.
signIn.unreachable: We couldn’t reach our server. Check your connection and try again.
signIn.banned: This account is banned. If you think that’s a mistake, write to us from the Contact page.

forgot.heading: Reset your password
forgot.body: Enter the email you joined with. We’ll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If there’s an account for {{email}}, we’ve sent it a link to reset the password.
forgot.spam: Nothing after a few minutes? Check your spam folder, or send the link again.

reset.heading: Choose a new password
reset.body: At least 10 characters. You can paste it from a password manager. We check it isn’t on a list of leaked passwords.
reset.samePassword: That’s the password you have now. Choose a different one.
reset.expiredBody: Reset links work once and expire after an hour. Ask for a new one.
reset.doneBody: We logged you out on every other device and sent you an email about the change. You can see where you’re logged in under Settings.

notOpen.documentTitle: Not open in your country yet · {{productName}}
notOpen.heading: We’re not open in your country yet
notOpen.body: {{productName}} opens one country at a time, each after its own legal check. We’ll open in {{country}} later.
notOpen.bodyUnknown: {{productName}} opens one country at a time, each after its own legal check, and we couldn’t tell which country you’re in.
notOpen.noEmail: We don’t keep a waiting list, so there’s nothing to sign up for yet. Check back later.

social.ageLine: You’ll still confirm your age. Google, Apple and Microsoft don’t tell us how old you are. They only replace your password. You still give your year of birth and do the age check.
social.logInFailed: We couldn’t open that way to log in. Try again, or log in with your email.

passkey.cancelled: No passkey was used. If this device has none for your account, log in with your email and add one in Settings.
passkey.failed: That passkey didn’t work. Try again, or log in with your email.

socialReturn.checking: One moment, we’re logging you in…

alreadyHasAccount.heading: You already have an account with this email
alreadyHasAccount.body: Log in the way you usually do, then connect this account in Settings, under Ways to log in. We never join two accounts without asking you.

linkTaken.heading: That account is already in use
linkTaken.body: It’s connected to a different account here. Log in to that one to use it, or choose another.

cancelled.heading: Nothing was changed
cancelled.body: You came back without logging in. You can try again whenever you like.

notJoined.heading: You haven’t joined yet
notJoined.body: There’s no account for that login, so we didn’t keep anything. Join first: it takes a minute, and you can use the same button there.

failed.heading: We couldn’t log you in
failed.body: Something went wrong on the way back. Try again, or log in with your email.

age.heading: Sorry, you can’t create an account right now
age.body: Your year of birth doesn’t meet our age rules, so we didn’t keep anything.

market.heading: We’re not open where you are yet
market.body: We didn’t keep anything. We’ll open in more countries soon.

username.heading: That username can’t be used
username.body: Someone may have taken it in the meantime. We didn’t keep anything: go back and choose another.

invite.heading: You need an invite to join
invite.body: Joining is by invite for now. We didn’t keep anything: open your invite link and try again.

terms.heading: The terms changed while you were away
terms.body: We didn’t keep anything. Go back, read the current terms and try again.

other.heading: We couldn’t create your account
other.body: We didn’t keep anything. Go back and try again.
